1.1.1.e: The letters आ, ऐ and  औ are called 'वृद्धि'.

1.1.2.e: The letters अ, ए and ओ are called 'गुण'.

1.1.3.e: If the words गुण or वृद्धि are used to denote the operation of  गुणादेश or वृद्धि-आदेश without specifying where such an आदेश happens, then this आदेश should be done in place of the 'इक्' letter.

1.1.4.e: If a part of धातु gets removed due to an आर्धधातुक प्रत्यय, then that प्रत्यय cannot cause any  गुण or वृद्धि on the इक् letter of the remaining part of that धातु.

1.1.5.e: In presence of a कित्,  गित् or a ङित् प्रत्यय, any गुण or वृद्धि that might happen on an इक्-letter of an अङ्ग is prohibited.

1.1.6.e: The इक् letter of - (a) the verb दीधीङ्,  (b) The verb वेवीङ् , and (c) इडागम - do not undergo a गुण or a वृद्धि.

1.1.7.e: Group of two or more  व्यञ्जनानि pronounced together without any स्वर or a pause between them is referred as संयोग.

1.1.8.e: A letter whose pronunciation needs the usage of nose as well as mouth is called an अनुनासिक.

1.1.9.e: Two letters are called सवर्ण of each other if their mouth-based location of pronunciation and their आभ्यन्तरप्रयत्न are same as of each other.

1.1.10.e: A स्वर and a व्यञ्जन cannot be सवर्ण of each other.

1.1.11.e: दीर्घ-ईकारान्त, दीर्घ-ऊकारान्त and एकारान्त forms of द्विवचन are known as 'प्रगृह्य'.

1.1.12.e: The forms of the अदस् word which end in मी / मू / मे are known as 'प्रगृह्य'.

1.1.14.e: Except for the word आङ्, all other निपाताः that contain only one स्वर (and no व्यञ्जन) are known as प्रगृह्य.

1.1.15.e: All ओकारान्त निपातs are known as प्रगृह्य.

1.1.16.a: शाकल्यस्य (मतेन) सम्बुद्धौ ओत् अनार्षे इतौ प्रगृह्यम्
1.1.16.e: According to Shakalya, the ओकार at end of the सम्बोधन-एकवचन form, when followed by the word 'इति' in a non vedic context, gets the term प्रगृह्य.

1.1.17.e: According to Shakalya, the निपात 'उञ्', when followed by the word 'इति' in a non vedic context, gets the term 'प्रगृह्य'.

1.1.18.e: An  ईकारान्त and an ऊकारान्त word that represents the meaning of सप्तमी gets the term 'प्रगृह्य'.

1.1.19.e: Except for the verbs दाप् and दैप्, all other verbs that are referred to as 'दारूपाः' or 'धारूपाः' are known as 'घु'.

1.1.20.e: If a word has a single letter, it acts as the first letter, and it also acts as the last letter.

1.1.21.e: The तरप् प्रत्यय and the तमप् प्रत्यय are known as 'घ'

1.1.22.e: The words बहु and गण, and the words ending in the वतुँप् and डति प्रत्यय are known as 'संख्या'.

1.1.23.e: The षकारान्त and the नकारान्त words which are referred to as 'संख्या' are also called 'षट्'.

1.1.24.e: The word ending in the डति प्रत्यय which is referred to as 'संख्या' is also called 'षट्'.

1.1.26.e: The words belonging to the सर्वादिगण are called सर्वनाम.

1.1.27.e: The words of सर्वादिगण in a दिशावाची बहुव्रीहि समास are optionally considered सर्वनाम.

1.1.28.e: The words of सर्वादिगण, when used to create a बहुव्रीहिसमास are not called सर्वनाम.

1.1.29.e: The words of the सर्वादिगण participating in a तृतीयासमास are not called सर्वनाम.

1.1.30.e: The words formed by the द्वन्द्व समास of the words of सर्वादिगण are not called सर्वनाम.

1.1.31.e: The words formed by the द्वन्द्व समास of the words of सर्वादिगण are optionally called सर्वनाम when they get the 'जस्' pratyay.

1.1.32.e: The words - प्रथम, चरम, अल्प, अर्ध, कतिपय, and नेम ; and also the words ending in the 'तयप्' प्रत्यय are optionally called सर्वनाम when they get the 'जस्' प्रत्यय.

1.1.33.e: The words 'पूर्व', 'पर', 'अवर', 'दक्षिण', 'उत्तर', 'अपर' and 'अधर'; when used in the sense of 'limit' but not as a proper noun; are optionally called सर्वनाम when followed by the जस् प्रत्यय.

1.1.34.e: The word 'स्व', when used in a meaning different than 'relatives' and 'money'  is optionally called सर्वनाम when followed by the जस् प्रत्यय.

1.1.35.e: The word  'अन्तर', when used in the meaning of 'outside a certain place' or 'undergarment', is optionally called 'सर्वनाम' when followed by the 'जस्' प्रत्यय.

1.1.36.e: The words of the स्वरादिगण and the words which are called 'निपात' are all also known as 'अव्यय'.

1.1.37.e: A तद्धितान्त word to which all the विभक्तिप्रत्ययाः cannot be attached is known as 'अव्यय'.

1.1.38.e: A word that ends in - (a) a मकारान्त कृत्-प्रत्यय,  or (b) a कृत्-प्रत्यय that ends in the एच् letter - is known as 'अव्यय'.

1.1.39.e: The words ending in क्त्वा, तोसुन् and कसुन् प्रत्यय are known as 'अव्यय'.

1.1.40.e: The word formed using an अव्ययीभाव समास are known as अव्यय.

1.1.42.e: The सुँ, औ, जस्, अम्, and औट् प्रत्ययाः attached to a non-नपुंसकलिङ्ग word are called 'सर्वनामस्थान'.

1.1.43.e: The word विभाषा is used to indicate the meaning of 'optional negation' and 'optional application'.

1.1.44.e: An 'इक्' letter that comes as a replacement for a 'यण्' letter is known as सम्प्रसारण.

1.1.45.e: A टित्-आगम is attached before its substrate, and a कित्-आगम comes after its substrate.

1.1.46.e: A मित्-आगम is attached after the last स्वर of its substrate.

1.1.47.e: When an 'एच्' letter undergoes a हस्वादेश, it is replaced by an 'इक्' letter.

1.1.48.e: When the षष्ठी विभक्ति occurring in a sutra does not indicate a clear relationship,  it is considered to indicate the स्थानी.

1.1.49.e: Out of multiple आदेशाः possible in a place, the one that is closest in properties gets selected.

1.1.50.e: Any अ, आ, इ, ई, उ, ऊ letter appearing as an आदेश in place of a ऋकार/ऌकार is always followed by the letter र्/ल् respectively.

1.1.51.e: आदेश told in a sutra happens in the place of the last letter of the स्थानी.

1.1.52.e: A ङित्-आदेश happens to the last letter of the  स्थानी.

1.1.53.e: The आदेश told on the latter word of a given निमित्त happens on its first letter.

1.1.54.e: An आदेश which either has more than one letters, or is शित् - replaces the entire स्थानी.

1.1.55.e: An आदेश acts like a स्थानी in the context of the operations that are not associated with a single letter.

1.1.56.e: An आदेश done in place of an अच् letter due to the परनिमित्त acts like the स्थानी even in the context of कार्याणि that are associated with a single letter; as long as the कार्याणि are on an entity prior to the location of the स्थानी.

1.1.57.e: An आदेश done in place of an अच् letter due to the परनिमित्त never acts like a स्थानी; even for the single-letter-कार्याणि done on an entity prior to the location of the स्थानी; in the context of -  (1) पदान्तकार्य  (2) द्वित्वकार्य  (3) 'वरच्' प्रत्ययकार्य (4) यकारलोप  (5) स्वरविधि (6) सवर्णकार्य (7) अनुस्वारविधि (8) दीर्घादेशकार्य (9) जश्त्वकार्य and (10) चर्त्वकार्य.

1.1.58.a: अचः आदेशः परस्मिन् अचि द्विर्वचने पूर्वविधौ स्थानिवत्
1.1.58.e: An आदेश done in place of an अच् letter acts like a स्थानी for the द्वित्वकार्य, provided that such a द्वित्वकार्य is caused by an अजादि षनिमित्त.

1.1.59.e: non-appearance of a letter or a group of letters is called लोप.

1.1.60.e: The elision of a प्रत्यय done using the specific words लुक्, श्लु and लुप् is respectively known by the terms लुक्, श्लु, लुप्.

1.1.61.e: The कार्य associated with a प्रत्यय happens even when the प्रत्यय undergoes a लोप.

1.1.62.e: A प्रत्यय that has been removed लुक् , श्लु or लुप् does not cause any अङ्गकार्यम्.

1.1.63.e: The fragment of a word starting from its last अच् letter till the end is called टि.

1.1.64.e: The second-last letter of a word is called उपधा.

1.1.65.e: The words in the सप्तमी विभक्ति are used to indicate that the कार्य happens on an immediately previous entity.

1.1.66.e: The words in the पञ्चमी विभक्ति are used to indicate that the कार्य happens on an immediately next entity.

1.1.67.e: The words used in the rules of the grammar represent the verbatim sequence of the letters (and not their underlying meaning); except for the technical terms which represent the meaning rather than the verbatim sequence of the letters.

1.1.68.e: An अण् letter which does not represent an आदेश, and an उदित letter (one of कु, चु, टु, तु, पु) used in a sutra represent all the सवर्ण forms.

1.1.69.e: A letter that follows or is followed by 'त्' represents only those सवर्णाः which require the same time for pronunciation as that letter.

1.1.70.a: अन्त्येन इता सह आदिः स्वस्य रूपस्य
1.1.70.e: A beginning letter, when combined with an ending इत् letter, stands for itself and for all the letters in between.

1.1.71.e: A विधि mentioned using an adjective happens in the context of that adjective, and also in context of the words which end in that adjective.

1.1.72.e: A word whose first स्वर is वृद्धि is called 'वृद्ध'.

1.1.73.e: The words of the त्यदादिगण are called  'वृद्ध'.

1.2.1.e: The non-ञित् and non-णित्  प्रत्ययाः attached to the - (1) the 'गाङ्' आदेश (that happens to the धातु 'इङ् अध्ययने'), and (2) the verbs of the कुटादिगण (an अन्तर्गण of तुदादिगण) - behave as if they are ङित्.

1.2.2.e: A प्रत्यय that gets an इडागम is considered ङित् when attached to the dhatu 'विज्'.

1.2.3.e: After the verb ऊर्ण 'to cover', the affix beginning with the augment इट् is regarded optionally like ङित्।

1.2.4.e: An अपित् सार्वधातुकप्रत्ययः behaves like a ङित् प्रत्यय.

1.2.5.e: For a verb root that does not end in a संयोग, the अपित् प्रत्यय of  लिट्-लकार behaves like a कित् प्रत्यय.

1.2.6.e: The लिट् (Perfect Tense) affixes after the roots इन्धि 'to kindle' and भू 'to become' are also कित्।

1.2.7.e: The affix क्त्वा is कित् after मृड् 'to be gracious', मृद् 'to squeeze', गुध् 'to wrap up', कुष् 'to tear', क्लिश् 'to suffer', वद् 'to speak' and वस् 'to dwell'.

1.2.8.e: The affixes क्त्वा and सन् [[3.1.7]] are कित् after रुद् 'to weep', विद् 'to know', मुष् 'to steal', गृह् 'to seize', स्वप् 'to sleep' and प्रच्छ् 'to ask'.

1.2.9.e: The affix सन् beginning with a letter of the प्रत्यहार झल् is like कित् after the verbs ending in इक् vowels.

1.2.10.e: And after a root ending in a consonant and preceded by a vowel of the प्रत्यहार इक् , the affix सन् beginning with a झल् consonant, is like कित् ।

1.2.11.e: After roots ending in a consonant, that adjoins a vowel of इक् प्रत्यहार , the substitutes of the -- विधिनिमन्त्रणामन्त्रण अधीष्टसम्प्रश्नप्रार्थनेषु लिङ् [[3.3.161]] and सिच् -- च्लेः सिच् [[3.1.44]], when they begin with a consonant of झल् प्रत्यहार , are कित् when the आत्मनेपद affixes follow.

1.2.12.e: And after the verbs ending in ऋ , the substitutes of लिङ् and the affix सिच् , are कित् , when they begin with झल् and the आत्मनेपद affixes follow.

1.2.13.e: Optionally after the verb गम् , the लिङ् and the सिच् beginning with झल् consonants, in the आत्मनेपद , are कित्।

1.2.14.e: The सिच् आत्मनेपद affixes are कित् after the root हन् 'to kill'.

1.2.15.e: The affix सिच् before आत्मनेपद affixes is कित् after the verb यम् when meaning 'to divulge'.

1.2.16.e: The affix सिच् before आत्मनेपद affixes is कित् optionally when यम् means 'to expose'.

1.2.17.e: The affix सिच् before आत्मनेपद affixes is कित् after स्था 'to stand' and घु मृषस्तितिक्षायाम् [[1.2.20]] verbs, and these verbs change their आ into इ before these terminations.

1.2.18.e: The affix क्त्वा when it takes the augment इट् (i.e. when it is सेट्) is not कित् ।

1.2.19.e: The सेट् निष्ठा affixes are not कित् after the verbs शीङ् 'to lie down', स्विद् 'to sweat', मिद् 'to melt', क्ष्विद् 'to be unctuous', and दृश् 'to offend'.

1.2.20.e: The सेट् निष्ठा affix is not कित् after the verb मृष् 'to forbear'.

1.2.21.e: The सेट् निष्ठा affix is optionally not कित् after the verbs with a penultimate उ if used impersonally or denoting the beginning of action.

1.2.22.e: The सेट् निष्ठा affix and the सेट् क्त्वा are not कित् after the verb पुङ् 'to purify'.

1.2.23.e: The सेट् क्त्वा is optionally कित् after the verbs having a penultimate न् ending in a थ् and फ्।

1.2.24.e: The सेट् क्त्वा is optionally कित् after the verbs वञ्च् 'to cheat', लुञ्च् 'to pluck' and ऋत् 'to dare or abhor'.

1.2.25.e: The सेट् क्त्वा is optionally कित् , according to the opinion of ऋषि काश्यप after the verbs तृष् 'to be thirsty', मृष् 'to sprinkle' and कृश् 'to become lean'.

1.2.26.e: After a verb which begins in a consonant and ends in a letter of रल् प्रत्यहार and has as its penultimate इ or ई and उ or ऊ , the क्त्वा and सन् affixes are optionally कित् ।

1.2.27.e: Vowels are classified as ह्रस्व, दीर्घ and प्लुत based on the time taken for their pronunciation, as compared against the time of उ, ऊ and उ3 respectively.

1.2.28.e: Action denoted by the words ह्रस्व / दीर्घ / प्लुत happens in place of an अच् letter.

1.2.29.e: A vowel that is pronounced using the upper-half portion of its उच्चारणस्थान is known as उदात्त.

1.2.30.e: A vowel that is pronounced using the lower-half portion of its उच्चारणस्थान is known as अनुदात्त.

1.2.31.e: A vowel that is pronounced using the upper as well as lower portions of its उच्चारणस्थान is known as  स्वरित.

1.2.32.e: The first half part of a स्वरित-स्वर is considered उदात्त.

1.2.33.e: In addressing a person from a distance the tone is called एकश्रुति or monotony.

1.2.34.e: In sacrificial works there is Monotony, except in जप (silent repetition of a formula), न्यूङ्ख vowels (16 sorts of ओम्) and the साम Vedas.

1.2.35.e: The pronunciation of the word वषट् , may optionally be by raising the voice (acutely accented), or it may be pronounced with monotony.

1.2.36.e: The monotony is optional in the recitation of the Vedas or they may be recited with accents.

1.2.37.e: There should be no Monotony in the recitation of the सब्रह्मण्य hymns and in those hymns, the vowels, that would otherwise have taken the स्वरित accent, take the उदात्त accent instead.

1.2.38.e: The words देवा and ब्राह्मण in those hymns have अनुदात्त accent.

1.2.39.e: The Monotony takes the place of the अनुदात्त vowels which follow the स्वरित vowels, in close proximity (संहिता).

1.2.40.e: The accent called सन्नतर is substituted in the room of an अनुदात्त vowel, which has an उदात्त or स्वरित vowel following it.

1.2.41.e: A प्रत्ययः that contains only one letter is called अपृक्त ।

1.2.42.e: A तत्-पुरुष compound, the case of each member is the same, is called कर्मधारय or Appositional Determinative compound.

1.2.43.e: In (this book, in the sūtras relating to) compound, the word that is exhibited in the Nominative -1st case, is called उपसर्जन or the secondary word.

1.2.44.e: A word which is one fixed case, (while the word compounded with it may vary its case) is also उपसर्जन , except for the purposes of the the rule which requires the उपसर्जन to stand first in a compound.

1.2.45.e: A meaningful word which is not a धातु, not a प्रत्यय, and which does not end in  प्रत्यय is called a 'प्रातिपदिक'.

1.2.46.e: कृत्-प्रत्ययान्त words, तद्धितप्रत्ययान्त words and the सामासिकशब्दाः are known as प्रातिपदिक.

1.2.47.e: The last letter of an अजन्त प्रातिपदिक is becomes हस्व in context of नपुंसकलिङ्ग.

1.2.48.e: A short vowel is the substitute of प्रातिपदिक which ends with the word गो 'a cow' and of that which ends with what has as its termination a feminine affix, when regarded as उपसर्जन।

1.2.49.e: When a तद्धित affix is elided by the word लुक् there takes place the elision by लुक् of feminine affix of the उपसर्जन।

1.2.50.e: The short is substituted in the place of गोणी , when the तद्धित affix is elided by लुक्।

1.2.51.e: When a तद्धित affix is elided by using the word लुप् , then the gender and number (of the derivative word) agree with those of the original word.

1.2.52.e: And of adjectives (the gender and number are the same as of the word formed by लुप् elision of the तद्धित and which they qualify) so far as the जाति (or kind of species) is concerned, (or when not expressing जाति).

1.2.53.e: This (concord or gender and number, of primitive and derivative nouns, and of attributes and substantives need not be taught (or approved), because it has the authority of संज्ञा (conventional term or idiom).

1.2.54.e: The sūtras declaring लुप् elision need not also be taught, because of the non-currency of the etymological meaning of the words supposed to be formed by लुप् elision.

1.2.55.e: And if the etymological meaning 'be held authoritative', then when such meaning is absent, the word also should vanish.

1.2.56.e: (Nor need be taught) the rule relating to the dependance of the meaning of a word on the principal (प्रधान in a compound) or on the affix (प्रत्यय) because the authority of the meaning (of a word, compound or derivative) consists in something else.

1.2.57.e: And a rule fixing the meaning of Tense (काल) and उपसर्जन (sequence) is equally (unnecessary, and need not be taught).

1.2.58.e: In (a common) name (expressive of) class, in denoting the singular, the plural is optionally used.

1.2.59.e: The plural of the pronoun अस्मद् 'I', is used optionally, though the sense requires a singular or a dual number.

1.2.60.e: And the dual of फाल्गुनी and प्रष्ठपदा , when signifying asterisms, (also connotes optionally plural).

1.2.61.e: In the Vedas, the two stars, पुनर्वासू , may optionally be singular, (and connote a dual).

1.2.62.e: In the Vedas, the two stars विशाखा may optionally be in the singular number.

1.2.63.e: In the द्वन्द compounds of the stars तिष्व and पुनर्वसू , the dual constantly comes in place of the plural.

1.2.64.e: If two or more words have identical forms for all विभक्तिs, then in usage only one word is used by applying appropriate वचन to it.

1.2.65.e: The वृद्ध (or patronymic गोत्र word becomes एकशेष and is retained, when compounded) with a patronymic word युवन् , provided that the specific difference in form between them be in their signs (affix) only.

1.2.66.e: And so also a feminine word, ending with a वृद्ध affix, when similarly spoken along with the same word but which ends with a युवन् affix, is only retained and it is treated like a masculine.

1.2.67.e: A word in the masculine gender, similarly spoken along with the same word, but ending with the feminine affix, becomes एकशेष and the latter is dropped.

1.2.68.e: The words भ्रातृ 'brother' and पुत्र 'son', when spoken of along with स्वसृ 'sister' and दुहितृ 'daughter' respectively are only retained and the latter are dropped.

1.2.69.e: A neuter noun, which has the same form, only differing in affix, is optionally retained and the other is dropped and it is like a singular number.

1.2.70.e: The word पितृ 'father' is optionally only retained when spoken of along with मातृ 'mother'.

1.2.71.e: The word श्वशुर 'father-in-law', is optionally only retained, when spoken of along with श्वशुरू 'mother-in-law'.

1.2.72.e: The pronouns त्यद् etc. when spoken of along with any other noun, (pronoun other than त्यद् etc.) are always retained as एकशेष (to the exclusion of others).

1.2.73.e: The feminine noun is only retained when denoting a collection of domestic animals, not being young.

1.3.1.e: The words भू and others, when used to denote an action, are called 'धातु'.

1.3.2.e: An अनुनासिक स्वर present in an उपदेश is called 'इत्'.

1.3.3.e: The ending हल् letter of  an उपदेश is called 'इत्'.

1.3.4.e: The letters - त्, थ्, द्, ध्, न्, स्, म् - occurring in the औपदेशिक form of a विभक्ति are not called 'इत्' ।

1.3.5.e: The groups ञि, टु and डु occurring at the beginning of an उपदेश are called 'इत्'.

1.3.6.e: The letter ष् at the beginning of the औपदेशिक form of a प्रत्यय is called 'इत्' ।

1.3.7.e: The letters - च्, छ्, ज्, झ्, ञ्, ट्, ठ्, ड्, ढ्, ण् -  at the beginning of the औपदेशिक form of a प्रत्यय are called इत् ।

1.3.8.a: उपदेशे अतद्धितस्य  प्रत्ययस्य आदिः ल-श-कु इत्
1.3.8.e: The letters ल्, श्, क्, ख्, ग्, घ्, ङ्  at the beginning of the औपदेशिक form of a non-तद्धित प्रत्यय are called इत् ।

1.3.9.e: The इत् letter is elided during the प्रक्रिया.

1.3.10.e: When a certain relation is given between two groups having same number of elements, then the relation is considered to exist only between the correspondingly positioned members of the two groups.

1.3.11.e: In this सूत्रपाठ, a स्वरित स्वर is used to denote अनुवृत्तिs.

1.3.12.e: A verb that contains (a) इत्संज्ञक ङकारः, or (b) an इत्संज्ञक अनुदात्त स्वर gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.

1.3.13.e: A verb gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद in the भावे and the कर्मणि प्रयोग.

1.3.14.e: A verb gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, even in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, in the context of व्यतिहार (exchange of actions).

1.3.15.e: The verbs indicating the action of - (a) movement,  or (2) violence - do not get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, in the context of व्यतिहार (exchange of actions).

1.3.16.e: A verb does not get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद  in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, in the context of व्यतिहार (exchange of actions) when either of the words 'इतरेतर' or 'अन्योन्य' is used to describe the situation.

1.3.17.e: When the उपसर्ग 'नि' is attached to the verb 'विश्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.

1.3.18.e: When any of the उपसर्गs - परि, वि, अव - is attached to the verb 'क्री', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.

1.3.19.e: When any of the उपसर्गs -  वि or  परा - is attached to the verb 'जि', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.

1.3.20.e: When the उपसर्ग आङ् is attached to the verb 'दा'; it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided that the  meaning is something other than 'opening the mouth'.

1.3.21.e: When any of the उपसर्गs - आङ् , अनु, सम or परि - is attached to the verb 'क्रीड्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.

1.3.22.e: When any of the उपसर्गs - सम् , अव, प्र, वि - is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.

1.3.23.e: The verb स्था gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद when used in the meaning of - (a) Clearing explaining own opinion, and (b) Putting and end to a question / debate.

1.3.24.e: When the उपसर्ग 'उत्' is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided that the meaning is not 'moving upwards / standing up'.

1.3.25.e: When the उपसर्ग 'उप' is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided the meaning is 'to approach using the मन्त्रs'.

1.3.26.e: When the उपसर्ग 'उप' is attached to the verb 'स्था', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verb is used in an अकर्मक sense.

1.3.27.e: When either of the उपसर्गs  - 'उत्', 'वि' - is attached to the verb 'तप्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of 'आत्मनेपद' ; provided that the verb is used in an अकर्मक sense.

1.3.28.e: When the उपसर्ग 'आङ्' is attached to verbs यम् /  हन् , they get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verbs are used in an अकर्मक sense.

1.3.29.e: When the उपसर्ग 'सम्' is attached to any of the verbs -  गम्,  ऋच्छ्, प्रच्छ्, स्वर्, ऋ, श्रु, विद् - they get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verbs are used in an अकर्मक sense.

1.3.30.e: When any of the उपसर्गs - नि, सम्, वि - is attached to the verb 'ह्वे', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.

1.3.31.e: When the उपसर्ग 'आङ्' is attached to the verb 'ह्वे', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of 'आत्मनेपद', provided the meaning is 'to complete / to wish to defeat'.

1.3.32.e:
The verb कृ gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, when used in the meanings of  - 
(1) गन्धनम् - To backbite, 
(2) अवक्षेपणम् - To defame, 
(3) सेवन् -  To serve or help out 
(4) साहसिक्यम् - To force someone to do something against their wish, To rape
(5) प्रतियत्न -To make someone change their character, 
(6) प्रकथनम् - To narrate, 
and
(7) उपयोग - To bring in practice, to use.

1.3.33.e: When the उपसर्ग 'अधि' is attached to the verb 'कृ', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the meaning is 'to forgive / to obtain victory'.

1.3.34.e: When the उपसर्ग 'वि' is attached to the verb 'कृ', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided the meaning is 'to make sound / to pronounce'.

1.3.35.e: When the उपसर्ग 'वि' is attached to the verb 'कृ', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the verb is used in an अकर्मक sense.

1.3.36.e: The verb नी  gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद  ; when used in the meaning of - (1) सम्मानन, To respect in an appropriate way (2) उत्सञ्जन, To lift up, to toss (3) आचार्यकरण, To convert someone into a teacher (by imparting proper knowledge to them) (4) ज्ञान, To decide, fix upon (5) भृतिः, Employ someone by giving money (6) निगणन, To pay off, to give loan ;  and (7) व्यय, To spend.

1.3.37.e: The verb 'नी' when used in the कर्तरि  सकर्मकप्रयोग gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided that the कर्मपद does not represent either the body or a part of the body of an animal.

1.3.38.e: The verb 'क्रम्' gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, when it is used in the meaning of - (1) वृत्तिः , To progress without getting stuck  , (2) सर्गः, enthusiasm, (3) तायनः, expansion, elaboration.

1.3.39.e: When the verb 'क्रम्' comes with an उपसर्ग, it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद only in the meaning of - (1) वृत्तिः , To progress without getting stuck  , (2) सर्गः, enthusiasm, (3) तायनः, expansion, elaboration.

1.3.40.e: When the उपसर्ग 'आङ्' is attached to the verb 'क्रम्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided the meaning is 'to rise, to travel upwards'.

1.3.41.e: When the उपसर्ग 'वि' is attached to the verb 'क्रम्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद, provided the meaning is 'to roam around with feet'.

1.3.42.e: When the उपसर्ग 'प्र' or 'उप' is attached to the verb 'क्रम्', it gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद ; provided that the meaning expressed is 'the beginning of'.

1.3.43.e: When the verb क्रम् is used without any उपसर्ग, it optionally gets the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद.

1.3.44.e: After the verb ज्ञ , when used in the sense of 'denying', the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.45.e: And when used intransitively after the verb ज्ञ , the आत्मनेपद is used, when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

1.3.46.e: After the verb ज्ञ , preceded by सम् and प्रति , the आत्मनेपद is used, when Not Used in the sense of 'remembering with regret'.

1.3.47.e: After the verb वद् , the आत्मनेपद is used, when used in the senses of 'showing brilliance, or proficiency in', pacifying', 'knowledge', 'effort', 'difference of opinion' and 'flattering'.

1.3.48.e: After the verb वद् , the आत्मनेपद is used, when used in the sense of 'speaking articulately in a similar manner'.

1.3.49.e: After the verb वद् , preceded by अनु when it is intransitively used, the आत्मनेपद is used, when the sense is that of 'speaking articulately in a similar manner'.

1.3.50.e: After the verb वद् , the आत्मनेपद is used optionally, when the sense is that of 'contradicting with each other'.

1.3.51.e: After the verb गॄ 'to swallow', when preceded by अव, the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.52.e: After the verb गॄ 'to swallow', when preceded by सम् , the आत्मनेपद affix is used in the sense of 'promising'.

1.3.53.e: After the verb चर् 'to walk' preceded by उत् , when used intransitively, the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.54.e: After the verb चर् 'to walk' preceded by सम् , and when connected with a noun in the Instrumental - 3rd Case, the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.55.e: And after the verb दा 'to give', preceded by सम् , and connected with a noun in the Instrumental - 3rd Case, the आत्मनेपद affix is used, provided this Instrumental Case has the sense of the Dative - 4th Case.

1.3.56.e: After the verb यम् 'to give', preceded by उप , when used in the sense of 'espousing', the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.57.e: After the Desideratives formed by the affix सन् , of the verbs ज्ञा 'to know', श्रु 'to hear', स्मृ 'to remember' and दृश् 'to see', the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.58.e: After the Desiderative of ज्ञा 'to know' when preceded by अनु , the आत्मनेपद affix is Not used.

1.3.59.e: After the Desideratives of श्रु 'to hear', when preceded by प्रत and आङ् , the आत्मनेपद affix is Not used.

1.3.60.e: After the verb शद् 'to decay', when it has one of the affixes with an indicatory श् (शित्) the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.61.e: After the verb मृ 'to die', when it has one of the affixes having an indicatory श् , as well as when it takes the affixes लुङ् (Aorist [[3.2.110]]) and लिङ् (Benedictive [[3.3.159]]), the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.62.e: The verb which is आत्मनेपदि in its primitive form before taking of the affix सन् , will also be आत्मनेपदि when it ends in the affix सन्। in other words; after a Desiderative verb, आत्मनेपद is used, if it would have been used after the primitive verb.

1.3.63.e: When the verb root कृ is used after the आम् प्रत्यय, the verb root कृ gets the same पद as the original verb to which the आम् प्रत्यय has been attached.

1.3.64.e: After the verb युज् 'to join', the आत्मनेपद is used, when it is preceded by प्र and उप except with reference to sacrificial vessels even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

1.3.65.e: After the verb क्षणु 'to sharpen', preceded by सम् , the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.66.e: After the verb भुज् , the आत्मनेपद is used, except in the sense of protecting.

1.3.67.e: After a verb ending in the affix णि (causal) the आत्मनेपद is used, provided that when the object in the non-णि or non-causal sense becomes the agent in the causal; and when it does not mean 'to remember with regret', even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

1.3.68.e: After the causatives of the verbs भी 'to fear' and स्मि 'to wonder' even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent the आत्मनेपद is employed, when the fear is produced directly by the causative agent.

1.3.69.e: After the causatives of the verbs गृध 'to covet' and वञ्च 'to go' the आत्मनेपद is used in the sense of 'deceiving' even though the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

1.3.70.e: After the causative of the verb लि 'to melt or stick', the आत्मनेपद is employed, when used in the sense of showing respect, subduing and deceiving, even though the fruit of action does not accrue to the agent.

1.3.71.e: After the causative of the verb कृ , the आत्मनेपद is used, when it has the word मिथ्या 'incorrect', as an उपपद or dependent word and is used in the sense of 'repeated wrong utterance', even when the fruit of action does not accrue no the agent.

1.3.72.e: A verb that contains इत्संज्ञक ञकार or an इत्संज्ञक स्वरित स्वरः gets the प्रत्यया of आत्मनेपद when the doer of the action does the action for himself.

1.3.73.e: After the verb वद् 'to tell', preceded by अप , when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent, the terminations are of the आत्मनेपद।

1.3.74.e: After a verb ending in the affix णि (causal) when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent, the आत्मनेपद is used.

1.3.75.e: After the verb यम् 'to strive', preceded by सम् , उत् and आङ् , when it does not refer to a book, the आत्मनेपद is used, when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

1.3.76.e: After the verb ज्ञा , when not preceded by any उपसर्ग , the terminations are of the आत्मनेपद , when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

1.3.77.e: The आत्मनेपद is optionally used, when the fact of the fruit of the action accruing to the agent is indicted by an उपपदग i.e. by a word used along with the verb.

1.3.78.e: The verbs that do not get the प्रत्ययाः of आत्मनेपद will get the प्रत्ययाः of परस्मैपद.

1.3.79.e: After the verb कृ 'to make' preceded by the अनु and पर , परस्मैपद is used, even the fruit of the action goes to the agent and when the sense is that of 'divulging' etc.

1.3.80.e: After the verb क्षिप् 'to throw', coming after अभि , प्रति and अति , परस्मैपद is used, even though the fruit of the action goes to the agent

1.3.81.e: After the verb वह् 'to bear', coming after प्र , परस्मैपद is used, even though the fruit of the action accrues to the the agent.

1.3.82.e: After the verb मृष् 'to bear', preceded by परि , परस्मैपद is used when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

1.3.83.e: After the verb रम् 'to sport', preceded by वि and आङ् , परस्मैपद is used.

1.3.84.e: And also after उप , the verb रम् takes the affixes of the परस्मैपद।

1.3.85.e: After the verb रम् 'to sport', preceded by उप , परस्मैपद is optionally used, when employed intransitively.

1.3.86.e: After the verbs बुध् 'to know', युध् 'to fight', नश् 'to destroy', जन 'to be born', एङ् 'to go', प्रु 'to move', द्रु 'to run' and स्रु 'to flow', ending in the affix णे (i.e. when used in the causative), परस्मैपद is used, even when the fruit of the action goes to the agent.

1.3.87.e: And after the causatives of verbs which have no sense of the 'eating or swallowing' and 'shaking or moving' परस्मैपद is used, even when the fruit of the action goes to the agent.

1.3.88.e: The affixes of the परस्मैपद are used after the causal of that verb, which in its non-causal state was intransitive and had a being endowed with reason for its agent, even when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

1.3.89.e: But the affixes of the परस्मैपद are not used after the causals of the verbs पा 'to drink', दम् 'to tame', आयम् 'to extend', आयस् 'to exert oneself', परिमुह 'to be bewildered', रुच् 'to shine' नृत् 'to dance', वद् 'to speak' and वस् 'to dwell'.

1.3.90.e: The affixes of the परस्मैपद are used optionally after the denominative verbs ending in the affix क्यष।

1.3.91.e: After the verbs द्युत् 'to shine' etc., the terminations of the परस्मैपद are optionally employed, when the affixes of लुण् (Aorist) follow.

1.3.92.e: After the verbs वृत् 'to exist' etc., परस्मैपद is optionally used when the affixes स्य (Future and conditional) and सन् (Desiderative) follow.

1.3.93.e: After the verb क्लिप् 'to be fit', परस्मैपद is optionally used, when लुट् (1st Future) is affixed, as well as when स्य and सन् are affixed.

1.4.1.e: If a word is given two संज्ञाs  under this अधिकार, and if the संज्ञा given by the later sutra can only be given whenever the संज्ञा given by the earlier sutra is given, then under such circumstances, the word gets only the संज्ञा given by the later sutra, not the earlier sutra.

1.4.2.e: If two sutras that can be invoked independent of each other happen to conflict at the same step during a प्रक्रिया, then the later occurring sutra gets applied by precedence.

1.4.3.e: The दीर्घ-ईकारान्त and दीर्घ-ऊकारान्त words which are only used as स्त्रीलिङ्ग forms get the term 'नदी'.

1.4.4.e: Except for the word 'स्त्री', any other word which is eligible for getting an इयङ्-आदेश or an उवङ्-आदेश is not referred to as नदी.

1.4.5.a: इयङ्-उवङ्-स्थानौ यू स्त्र्याख्यौ आमि नदी वा, अस्त्री
1.4.5.e: Except for the word 'स्त्री', any other word which is eligible for getting an इयङ्-आदेश or an उवङ्-आदेश optionally gets the term नदी in presence of the आम् प्रत्यय of षष्ठी बहुवचन.

1.4.6.a: इयङ्-उवङ्-स्थानौ यू स्त्र्याख्यौ, ह्रस्वः च, ङिति नदी वा, अस्त्री
1.4.6.e: Except for the word 'स्त्री', any other word which is eligible for getting an इयङ्-आदेश or an उवङ्-आदेश, and any ह्रस्व-इकारान्त/हस्व-उकारान्त word optionally gets the term नदी in presence of a ङित् प्रत्यय.

1.4.7.e: Except for the word सखि, all ह्रस्व-इकारान्त and ह्रस्व-उकारान्त words get the term घि whenever they do not get the term नदी.

1.4.8.e: The word पति gets the term घि only when used in a समास.

1.4.9.e: The word पति, when associated with a word of षष्ठी विभक्ति, optionally gets the term घि in वेदाः.

1.4.10.e: A ह्रस्व स्वर gets the term लघु.

1.4.11.e: A ह्रस्व स्वर which is followed by a संयोग gets the term गुरु.

1.4.12.e: A दीर्घ स्वर gets the  term गुरु.

1.4.13.e: When a प्रत्यय is attached to a word, everything that begins with the first letter of that word up to (and excluding) the first letter of the प्रत्ययः itself, is called the an अङ्गम् of that प्रत्यय.

1.4.14.e: Any word ending in a सुप् प्रत्यय or a तिङ् प्रत्यय is called a पद.

1.4.15.e: A नकारान्त word gets the term 'पद' when followed by a प्रत्यय that begins with क्य.

1.4.16.e: In presence of a प्रत्यय having सकार as इत्संज्ञक, the प्रकृति gets the term पद.

1.4.17.e: If a प्रत्यय which is not a सर्वनामस्थान and which is specified in the fourth or fifth chapter gets attached to an प्रकृति , the प्रकृति gets the term पद.

1.4.18.e: If a यकारादि or an अजादि प्रत्यय which is not a सर्वनामस्थान and which is specified in the fourth or fifth chapter gets attached to a प्रकृति , the प्रकृति gets the term भ.

1.4.19.e: A तकारान्त or a सकारान्त word gets the term 'भ' when followed by a  मत्वर्थीय प्रत्यय.

1.4.20.e: The 'अयस्मय' and other words should be considered valid words in the वैदिक literature.

1.4.21.e: For referring to many, the बहुवचन forms are used.

1.4.22.e: For referring to two, the द्विवचन forms are used, where as for referring to one, the एकवचन forms are used.

1.4.23.e: The phrase कारक (meaning 'in the special relation to a word expressing an action') is to be understood in the following aphorisms.

1.4.24.e: A noun whose relation to an action is that of a fixed point from which departure takes place is called अपादान or Ablation.

1.4.25.e: In case of words implying 'fear' and 'protection from danger' that from which the danger of fear proceeds is called अपादान कारक।

1.4.26.e: In the case of the verb पराजि 'to be tired or weary of', that which becomes unbearable, is called अपादान कारक।

1.4.27.e: In case of verbs having the sense of 'preventing, the desired object from which one is prevented or warded off', is called Ablation or अपदान कारक।

1.4.28.a: अन्तर्धौ येन अदर्शनम् इच्छति तत् कारकम् अपादानम्
1.4.28.e: When concealment is indicated, the person whose sight one wishes to avoid, is called अपादान कारक।

1.4.29.e: The noun denoting the teacher is called Ablation or अपादान , in relation to the action signifying formal teaching.

1.4.30.e: The prime cause of the agent of the verb जन् 'to be born', is called अपादान।

1.4.31.e: The source of the agent of the verb भू 'to become' is called अपादान।

1.4.32.e: The person whom one wishes to connect with the object of giving, is called सम्प्रदान or recipient.

1.4.33.e: In case of verbs having the signification of the root रुच् 'to like', the person or thing that is pleased or satisfied, is called सम्प्रदान or recipient.

1.4.34.e: In case of verbs श्लाघ् 'to praise', ह्नु 'to take away', स्था 'to stand', शप् 'to curse', the person whom it is intended to inform of or persuade by, these actions, is called सम्प्रदान।

1.4.35.e: In the case of the verb धारि 'to owe', the creditor is called सम्प्रदान।

1.4.36.e: In the case of the verb स्पृह् 'to desire', the thing desired is called सम्प्रदान कारक।

1.4.37.e: In the case of the verbs having the sense of क्रद्ध् 'to be angry', द्रुह् 'to injure', ईर्ष्या 'to envy', असूया 'to detract', the person against whom the feeling of anger etc. is directed is called सम्प्रदान।

1.4.38.e: But in the case of the verbs क्रुद्ध् and द्रुह् , when preceded by prepositions, the person against whom the feeling of anger etc. is directed is called कर्म कारक or object.

1.4.39.e: In the case of the verbs राध् 'to propitiate' and ईक्ष् 'to look to', the person about whose good or bad fortune questions are asked is called सम्प्रदान।

1.4.40.e: In the case of the verb श्रु preceded by the prepositions प्रति and अङ् and meaning 'to promise', the person to whom promise is made (literally: the person who as the agent of the former verb) is called सम्प्रदान।

1.4.41.e: In the case of the verb गृ preceded by अनु and प्रति and meaning 'to encourage by repeating', the person who was the agent of the prior action, which is repeated, is called सम्प्रदान।

1.4.42.e: That which is especially auxiliary in the accomplishment of the action is called Instrument or करण कारक।

1.4.43.e: That which is especially auxiliary in the accomplishment of the action, of the verb दिव् 'to play' is called कर्म - object, as well as करण।

1.4.44.e: In the case of hiring on wages, that which is especially auxiliary in the accomplishment of the action of the verb परिक्री 'employing on stipulated wages', is optionally called सम्प्रदान or recipient.

1.4.45.e: That which is related to the action as the site where the action is performed by reason of the agent or the object being in that place is called अधिकरण or location.

1.4.46.e: That which is the site of the verbs शीङ् 'to lie down', स्था 'to stand', आस् 'to sit', when preceded by the preposition अधि , is however called कर्म कारक or object.

1.4.47.e: That which is the site of the verb अभिनिविश् 'to enter', is also called कर्म कारक।

1.4.48.e: That which is the site of the verb वस् 'to dwell', when preceded by उप , अनु , and आङ् is called कर्म कारक।

1.4.49.e: That which is intended should be most effected by the act of the agent is called the object or कर्म।

1.4.50.e: If that which is not intended to be most affected by the act becomes however similarly connected with the action it also is called कर्म।

1.4.51.e: And if that कारक which is not spoken of as coming under any of the special relations of Ablation etc., is also called कर्म।

1.4.52.e: For verbs indicating motion (गति), knowledge (बुद्धि), eating (भक्षण); for verbs whose action involves a word (शब्दकर्म) ; and for the अकर्मक verbs the  कर्ता of the अप्रयोजक sentence becomes कर्म in the प्रयोजक sentence.

1.4.53.e: The agent of the verb in its non-णि (primitive) form in the case of हृ 'to lose' and कृ 'to make', is optionally called कर्म or object when these verbs take the affix.

1.4.54.e: Whatever the speaker chooses as the independent, principal and absolute source of action is called कर्ता or agent.

1.4.55.e: That which is the mover thereof, i.e. of the independent source of action, is called हेतु or cause, as well as कर्ता or agent.

1.4.56.e: The words discussed till <<अधिरीश्वरे>> [[1.4.97]] are known as निपात.

1.4.57.e: The words included in the चादिगण are called निपात when used in a sense that does not denote an object.

1.4.58.e: The words belonging to the प्रादिगण are called उपसर्ग  when used along with a verb.

1.4.59.e: The words belonging to the प्रादिगण are also called गति when used along with a verb.

1.4.60.e: The words उरी 'assent' etc. and those that end with च्वि [[5.4.50]] and those that end with डाच् [[5.4.57]] (when in composition with the verb भू , कृ or अस् ) are called गति।

1.4.61.e: A word imitative of sounds is also called गति when it is not followed by the word इति।

1.4.62.e: The words सत् and असत् when in composition with a verb is called गति , when used in the sense of 'respect or love' and 'disrespect or indifference'.

1.4.63.e: The word अलम् when in composition with a verb is called गति , when used in the sense of 'ornament'.

1.4.64.e: The word अन्तर् is called गति , when used in the sense of 'non-accepting', when in composition with a verb.

1.4.65.e: The words कणे and मनस् are गति when in composition with a verb and used in the sense of 'reaction by satiation'.

1.4.66.e: The word पुरः 'in front of', when indeclinable and in composition with a verb, is called गति।

1.4.67.e: And the indeclinable word अस्तम् 'at home' is called गति , when in composition with a verb.

1.4.68.e: The indeclinable word अच्छ 'before in the presence of' is called गति , when used in the composition with verbs denoting 'motion' or with the verb वद् 'to speak'.

1.4.69.e: The word अदस् 'that' is called गति when in composition with a verb and not implying a direction to another.

1.4.70.e: The word तिरस् when used in the sense of 'disappearance' is called गति when in composition with a verb.

1.4.71.e: The word तिरस् 'disappearance' is optionally called गति when the verb कृ follows.

1.4.72.e: The words उपाजे and अनवाजे both meaning 'supporting or assisting the weak', are optionally called गति when used along with the verb कृ।

1.4.73.e: The words साक्षात् 'in the presence of' etc. are optionally called गति when used along with the verb कृ।

1.4.74.e: The word उर्सि 'in the breast' and मनसि 'in the mind' ae optionally called गति when the verb कृ follows, provided that they are not used in the sense of 'placing'.

1.4.75.e: And the words मध्ये 'in the middle', पदे 'in the foot' and निवचने 'speechless' are optionally called गति , when कृ follows, the sense not being of placing.

1.4.76.e: The word हस्ते 'in the hand', पाणौ 'in the hand' are always necessarily called गति when used with the verb कृ in the sense of 'marriage'.

1.4.77.e: The indeclinable word प्रध्वम् followed by the verb कृ , is always called गति when in used in the sense of 'binding'.

1.4.78.e: The words जीविका and उपनिषद् followed by the verb कृ are called गति when used in the sense of 'likeness and resemblance'.

1.4.79.e: Words referred as उपसर्ग or गति are attached before the verb root.

1.4.80.e: In the छन्दस् (Veda) these गति and उपसर्ग are employed indifferently after the verbal root, as well as before it.

1.4.81.e: In the छन्दस् (Veda) these गति and उपसर्ग are also seen separated from the verb by intervening words.

1.4.82.e: From this point as far as aphorism [[1.4.97]] treated of, are to be understood as having the name of कर्म-प्रवचनीय।

1.4.83.e: The word अनु , when it denotes a sign, is called कर्म-प्रवचनीय।

1.4.84.e: The word अनु , कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it has the force of the 3rd case.

1.4.85.e: The word अनु , कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it is used in the sense of 'inferior or subordinate to'.

1.4.86.e: The word उप when it means 'superior' or 'inferior to' is कर्म-प्रवचनीय।

1.4.87.e: The words अप and परि are कर्म-प्रवचनीय when meaning 'exclusion'.

1.4.88.e: The word आङ् 'as far as', is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it expresses limit (e.g. when it means 'as far as inclusive of' or 'as far as exclusive of').

1.4.89.e: The words प्रति , परि and अनु are कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of 'sign' ('in the direction of') , 'mere statement of circumstances' ('as regards'), 'division', 'share of' and 'pervasion', severally.

1.4.90.e: The word अभि is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the above senses of 'in the direction of', 'as regards', and 'each severally', but not when it means 'division', 'share of'.

1.4.91.e: The word प्रति is कर्म -प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of representative ('representative of') or exchange ('in exchange for').

1.4.92.e: The words अधि and परि are कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used as mere expletives.

1.4.93.e: The word सु is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of respect, (when it means 'excellently').

1.4.94.e: The word अति in the sense of super-abundance ('excessively') and 'excellently' is कर्म-प्रवचनीय।

1.4.95.e: The word अपि is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it implies, the sense of word 'understood' ('somewhat') or 'possibility' (e.g. 'even' in the sense of such a great person), or permission to do as one likes, ('if you like'), or censure ('even' in the sense of what is disgraceful); or collection ('and').

1.4.96.e: The words अधि is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of 'lord' ('being as a lord' or 'having as a lord')

1.4.97.e: The words अधि is optionally कर्म-प्रवचनीय when the verb कृ follows.

1.4.98.e: The आदेशा that occur in place of a लकार are known as परस्मैपद.

1.4.99.e: The तङ्, शानच् and कानच् आदेशाः that occur in place of a लकार are known as आत्मनेपद.

1.4.100.e: The तिङ्-प्रत्ययाः, when grouped into groups of three, are sequentially known as प्रथम, मध्यम and उत्तम.

1.4.101.a: तानि त्रीणि त्रीणि तिङः एकवचन-द्विवचन-बहुवचनानि एकशः
1.4.101.e: The तिङ्-प्रत्ययाः are sequentially referred as एकवचन, द्विवचन and बहुवचन.

1.4.102.e: The सुप्-प्रत्ययाः are sequentially referred as एकवचन, द्विवचन and बहुवचन.

1.4.103.e: The सुप्-प्रत्ययाः and the तिङ्-प्रत्ययाः are called विभक्ति.

1.4.104.a: युष्मदि उपपदे समानाधिकरणे स्थानिनि अपि मध्यमः
1.4.104.e: Where a form of the word  युष्मद् shows the same substance which is shown by the लकार, there the तिङन्तपद must be expressed using the मध्यमपुरुष प्रत्ययाs.

1.4.105.a: मन्य-उपपदे प्रहासे मध्यमः । मन्यतेः उत्तमः एकवत् च ।
1.4.105.e: When one person wants to make fun of what other person thinks, and he uses the verb 'मन्' to indicate the thinking process, the verb मन् is used in उत्तमपुरुष-एकवचन and the other verb is used in  मध्यमपुरुष. For example, consider this statement - 'Do you think you can eat the rice' (एहि मन्ये ओदनम् भोक्ष्यसे)? Here the speaker is making fun of the thinking process of other person, saying that the other person is thinking he could eat the rice, but he would not be able to. In such a case, the verb मन् would get उत्तमपुरुष (instead of ideally getting मध्यमपुरुष), and the other word  (भुज् in this case) would get मध्यमपुरुष instead of ideally getting उत्तमपुरुष). So, instead of saying  रे बुभुक्षित, किम् त्वं एतत् मन्यसे यत् अहम् ओदनम् भोक्ष्ये, we would say - एहि मन्ये ओदनम् भोक्ष्यसे?

1.4.106.a: अस्मदि उपपदे समानाधिकरणे स्थानिनि अपि उत्तमः
1.4.106.e: Where a form of the word अस्मद् shows the same substance which is shown by the लकार, there the तिङन्तपद must be expressed using the उत्तमपुरुष प्रत्ययाs.

1.4.107.a: शेषे उपपदे समानाधिकरणे स्थानिनि अपि प्रथमः
1.4.107.e: Where a form of the word other than अस्मद् or युष्मद् shows the same substance which is shown by the लकार, there the तिङन्तपद must be expressed using the प्रथमपुरुष प्रत्ययाs.

1.4.108.e: Extreme closeness of letters is called संहिता.
